messages.content: I fitted new Assioma pedals this week.
Nice upgrade. How do the Assioma numbers compare to your old meter?
They read about 5W higher than my old power meter.
Good to know, the Assioma reads 5W higher, so I will adjust your targets up by that offset.
I also moved my hard sessions to the mornings.
Morning hard sessions work well when your sleep supports them.
My partner's schedule means weekends are capped at 2.5 hours until September.
Understood, weekends limited to 2.5 hours until September. I will keep long rides within that.
So how should we structure the next few weeks?
Let us run a 3-week block and then reassess.
Sounds good, a 3-week block then reassess.
To track load and recovery, can you send me a weekly weight trend?
I will think about the best way to log that.
No rush. Even a once-a-week figure helps.
Anything else for the gravel event prep?
We will layer in longer endurance rides as the weekends open up after September, aiming at the gravel event.
Keep me posted on how the Assioma pedals feel over the first few rides.
